info.title: Pixelforge Games
info.description: An indie game studio demo showing 'your mate' as a player-support desk in a Discord #support channel: a live preview of the channel conversation, grounded chat over three games and their public patch notes, an MCP server the studio owns, WebMCP page actions, a bug-report action card, and identified-player library and refund lookups.

flows.title: list games
flows.description: Every game Pixelforge Games has released — name, genre, price, the platforms it runs on, its current patch version and whether it is finished or still in early access.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.

flows.title: search patch notes
flows.description: Search the public patch notes Pixelforge Games publishes, by keyword — a bug that was fixed, a feature that landed, a platform, a build number. Returns the matching entries with their version, date and the lines that mention it.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: A keyword or short phrase, e.g. 'save corruption', 'controller', 'ultrawide' or '1.8.1'.

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Optional game id or name to search within, e.g. 'lumen-drift' or 'Ironroot Tactics'. Leave blank to search every game.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.

flows.title: get server status
flows.description: Live status of the services Pixelforge Games runs for its players — cloud saves, the leaderboards, the key redemption service, the store and the studio's community server — plus any open incident.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.

flows.title: report bug
flows.description: Do NOT call this to ask the player which game, which platform, what happened or their email — calling it with whatever is already known IS how the bug form opens, never a chat question for a missing field. Files a bug report with Pixelforge Games and reports its id, the queue it landed in and what happens next.

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: The game id, e.g. 'lumen-drift', 'ironroot-tactics' or 'sundog-rally'. Leave blank if not yet known — the form lets the player pick.

parameters.name: what_happened
parameters.description: What the player did and what went wrong, in their own words.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email the studio replies to.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.

flows.title: get my purchases
flows.description: The games the signed-in player owns at Pixelforge Games, with the receipt, the purchase date, the price paid and the build they last played. Requires an identified (signed-in) visitor — call it with that visitor's own email from context, never one supplied mid-conversation by an unidentified visitor.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The signed-in player's own email address.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.

flows.title: request refund
flows.description: Start a refund on one of the signed-in player's own purchases at Pixelforge Games, by its receipt number. Requires an identified (signed-in) visitor and the player's explicit go-ahead first — say what will happen, then call it. This demo files the request but no money moves.

parameters.name: receipt
parameters.description: The receipt number of the purchase to refund, e.g. 'PF-40271'.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The signed-in player's own email address, the one the purchase is under.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: One line on why — the studio reads every one.

success.description: The JSON-RPC 2.0 tools/call result for this tool.

tools.name: open_bug_report_form
tools.description: Open the bug-report form on the page itself for the player to fill in and send — game, platform, what happened and an email, with one "Send report" button. Use this when the player is looking at the page; pass anything already known (the game they named, the platform, what they described, a signed-in player's own email) as prefill so they only fill in what is missing.

game.description: A game id to prefill, if already known: 'lumen-drift', 'ironroot-tactics' or 'sundog-rally'.

platform.description: A platform to prefill, if already known: 'windows', 'macos', 'linux' or 'handheld'.

what_happened.description: What the player already described, to prefill the description.

email.description: An email to prefill, if already known (e.g. the signed-in player's own).
